verses.1: The words that came from Jehovah to Jeremiah were these:
verses.2: As Jehovah, the God of Israel, said: “I have written down all the things that I have spoken to you in a book.”
verses.3: For behold, days are coming, says the LORD; I will bring back the fortunes of my people Israel and Judah. The LORD says, “And they shall return to the land that I gave to their ancestors.”
verses.4: And these are the things that Jehovah spoke to Israel and to the Jews.
verses.5: For Jehovah has said, “We have heard a voice of fear; there is no peace at all.”
verses.6: Please ask and see if there is any male child. I saw that all of their hands were covered with dirt, just like a baby. All their faces became covered in dirt.
verses.7: Oh, how great today is this day! It’s as wonderful as any other day. But it’s a difficult time for Jacob. From this time onward, he will be in trouble.
verses.8: And on that day, the Lord’s army will remove them from atop your heads and from your bodies. They will no longer be able to serve those gods anymore.
verses.9: And they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, who I will make their king.
verses.10: And you, my servant Jacob, do not fear! The LORD says, “Do not be afraid of Israel. I will save you from faraway lands. My descendants will return from the land of Shittim.” Then Jacob will be safe and secure, without any danger.
verses.11: For I, the LORD, will save you. I will do all this in all the nations where you are scattered. But to you, I will not do any of this. You will be taken away to judgment. I will not save you.
verses.12: For as Jehovah said, “In your redemption, we shall receive a blessing from you.”
verses.13: You have no right to demand compensation for the damages caused by Rufot. You do not deserve it.
verses.14: All those who love you, but have forgotten about you, will not ask for forgiveness. For your actions are cruel and hateful; they cause harm to yourself through your own sins.
verses.15: How shall I cry out over your punishment? How painful is your suffering because of my sins! I have done these things to myself.
verses.16: Therefore, all your food will be eaten up, and all your possessions will be destroyed. You will be left with nothing to eat. And all your possessions will be given to others.
verses.17: For I will lift up my voice to you, and from your mouth I will heal you. Let the LORD say this: “It is Zion that is being rejected; she seeks no one else.”
verses.18: So said Jehovah: “I will restore the tent of Jacob and his dwelling places. I will build a city on its site, and a palace for the judge to reside in.”
verses.19: And from them came laughter and joyous voices. They became numerous, and they did not stop or become sad.
verses.20: And their sons were like those before them. I judged them in accordance with all their actions.
verses.21: And he became great from us, and his distance from us was shortened. He came close to me, and I rushed towards him. But who is this one who has filled my heart with longing to approach me? Oh Jehovah!
verses.22: And you shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.23: Look! The fierce storm of the LORD has come upon the heads of the wicked. It will bring destruction upon them.
verses.24: The house of God will not be rebuilt until it is done, and until it is restored to its original state. In those days, it will be rebuilt again.
